hero.subtitle: LittleFounders turns financial literacy and entrepreneurship into a game your kids actually want to play — safe, guided, and side by side with your family.
hero.imageAlt: A family learning about money together at the table with the LittleFounders characters

problem.title: The problem is real. So is the fix.
problem.problemBody: Money is one of the most important subjects in life — and one of the least taught. Most kids grow into adults without ever practicing how to save, budget, or build something of their own.
problem.solutionBody: Short, highly gamified lessons, an AI tutor that adapts to each child, and family tasks with real rewards — all under verified parental control.

fact.title: Only 1 in 3 adults worldwide is financially literate
fact.body: That's the finding of the S&P Global FinLit Survey, one of the largest studies on financial literacy ever conducted. Two out of three adults can't answer basic questions about saving, interest, and risk. We believe the fix starts in childhood.

motivation.title: Kids already dream big. We help them build.
motivation.body1: Every kid saving coins in a jar is already a little founder — they have a goal, a plan, and the patience to get there. What they're missing is a guide that speaks their language.
motivation.body2: LittleFounders meets them where they play: characters they love, quests they want to finish, and a family cheering them on.
motivation.imageAlt: A child counting coins next to a savings jar

features.title: Hands-on learning, at home
features.subtitle: Interact with money concepts directly. Our tactile world reduces the friction of learning and makes tough subjects feel like play.

f1.title: Gamification
f1.body: Earn XP, keep streaks alive, and unlock rewards as courses progress.

f2.title: AI Tutor
f2.body: A personal tutor that adapts to each child and gives gentle hints — never just the answer.

f3.title: Interactive lessons
f3.body: No lectures. Drag, drop, and build your way through every concept.

f5.title: Family tasks
f5.body: Parents assign tasks and set gamified rewards; several verified guardians per family.

f6.title: Safe by design
f6.body: Verified guardian links, moderated content, and no child data ever sold or shared.

finalCta.title: Raise a little founder
finalCta.body: Create a free account in minutes. No credit card required.
